items.title: Colmobil (Israel) hit by ransomware
items.summary: Israel's largest vehicle importer, Colmobil, was reported hit by a ransomware attack in the week ending November 1.

items.title: GOLD OGRE using AI agents in Aur0ra intrusions
items.summary: Check Point reports the GOLD OGRE group making heavy use of AI agents during Aur0ra attacks, with some campaigns moving on to credential theft, lateral movement and ransomware activity.

items.title: New leak-site postings, Oct 31 – Nov 2
items.summary: Ransomware.live lists fresh victim postings discovered Oct 31 to Nov 2 with estimated attack dates of Oct 26 and Nov 1; these are attacker claims and the victims have not confirmed them.

ransomware.note: Early-month coverage is thin: few named November victims are indexed yet.

items.title: Veeqo shipping options unavailable for all orders
items.summary: Veeqo's status page logged an incident in which shipping options were unavailable for all orders; it was resolved at 09:44 UTC on November 2.

items.title: GWU Foggy Bottom campus power outage hits network services
items.summary: A power outage across George Washington University's Foggy Bottom campus on November 2 affected GWorld, parking and network-based services while Pepco worked on restoration.

outage.note: No major AWS, Azure or Google Cloud outage reported in the past 72 hours; the last significant one was Azure gateway services across 18 regions, Sep 30 – Oct 1.

items.title: CISA adds two Ivanti Connect Secure zero-days to KEV
items.summary: CVE-2026-111357 and CVE-2026-118527 were added to KEV, with federal deadlines of Nov 2 and Nov 13; chained with CVE-2026-104935, they give root access and expose AD credentials, LAPS passwords and BitLocker keys.

items.title: Ivanti patches Connect Secure attack chain (UTA0576)
items.summary: Ivanti released patches for two more zero-days in the chain that Volexity attributes to UTA0576, and Rapid7 advises a compromise hunt after patching.

items.title: U.S. Homeland Security breach reported
items.summary: A breach at the U.S. Department of Homeland Security was among the incidents reported in the week ending November 1.

items.title: Binance theft
items.summary: A theft of funds from the Binance cryptocurrency exchange was reported in the same weekly roundup.

items.title: M 6.4 southeast of Easter Island
items.summary: USGS recorded an M 6.4 earthquake southeast of Easter Island on October 29, with a green PAGER alert and no tsunami flag.

items.title: Emergency water interruption, Puerto Rico village (Saipan, CNMI)
items.summary: Commonwealth Utilities Corporation issued an emergency water service interruption advisory for the Puerto Rico village on Saipan on November 2.

items.title: Record-pace Eastern Pacific hurricane season runs to Nov 30
items.summary: The 2026 Eastern Pacific season has been on a record pace and officially runs until November 30, so late-season storms affecting Mexico remain possible.

physical.note: No major November hurricane, typhoon, wildfire or flood event indexed yet. Late-October context: Hurricane Isaias (FL, Cat 2) and Typhoon Champi (Taiwan).
